strings.cooking_about: A faster, more generous kitchen. Trained by cooking.
strings.cooking_speed_tip: On cooking stations and the oven, for the food you put on.
strings.burn_delay_tip: A done dish takes that much longer to burn. The game burns it one cook time after it is done.
strings.fermenting_speed_tip: For the mead bases you put in a fermenter.
strings.craft_time_tip: At the cauldron, mead cauldron and prep table. The game's own Cooking bonus.
strings.extra_food_tip: At every kitchen: cooking stations, oven, cauldron, mead cauldron and prep table. Replaces the game's bonus food there.
strings.ingredient_saved_tip: Chance per craft at the cauldron, mead cauldron or prep table to get one used ingredient back.
strings.rich_dishes_tip: Experience grows with a dish's health + stamina + eitr: ×1 up to {0}, ×{1} from {2}.
strings.new_dish_tip: The first time you make each dish.
strings.crafting_perks: Extra food chance {0}%; ingredient save chance {1}%
strings.cfg_3_eating__eat_from_food_slots_automa: Whenever food in your configured Mantle Food slots can be eaten (a free food slot, or a food low enough that the game lets you eat it again), eat it using the game's normal eating rules. Consumes actual items; does nothing without Mantle Food slots.
strings.cfg_3_eating__food_slots_on_spawn_and_re: Food Slots On Spawn And Retrieval

After joining a world, respawning or fully retrieving your own tombstone, eat available food from your configured Mantle Food slots using the game's normal eating rules. Consumes actual items; does nothing without Mantle Food slots.
strings.cfg_import__preview_feastmaster_help: Preview the existing reference file; source unchanged. Resets after running.
strings.cfg_import__preview_grindstoneskills_hel: Preview the existing Cooking reference settings; source unchanged. Resets after running.
strings.cfg_import__apply_feastmaster_help: Applies the previewed FeastMaster import. Run it on the host; Larder backs up its settings first. The FeastMaster files are not changed. Turns itself off after running.
strings.cfg_import__apply_grindstoneskills_help: Applies the previewed GrindstoneSkills import. Run it on the host; Larder backs up its settings first. Star settings (removed from Larder) are reported, not imported. Resets after running.
strings.cfg_import__source_choices_help: Conflicts shown by Preview: target Section.Key=source id, separated by semicolons.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__safe_area_stamina_help: Actions switched on below cost no stamina while no hostile creature is within Safe Area Radius. Off keeps the ordinary Exertion rules.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__safe_area_radius_help: Radius in meters checked for hostile creatures. 0 counts only creatures touching you. Only creatures in loaded areas are checked.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__safe_area_ignored_creatu: Comma-separated creature prefab or displayed names that do not count as nearby enemies. Empty ignores nothing. Matching is case-insensitive.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__safe_area_sprint_help: Sprinting costs no stamina while safe.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__safe_area_jump_help: Jumping costs no stamina while safe.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__safe_area_build_help: Placing with the hammer, hoe and cultivator costs no stamina while safe.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__safe_area_swim_help: Free safe swimming; this also prevents stamina-driven drowning while safe.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__safe_area_attacks_help: Weapon and tool swings cost no stamina while safe. Holding a drawn bow still costs stamina.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__safe_area_sneak_help: Sneaking costs no stamina while safe.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__safe_area_encumbered_hel: While safe, encumbered walking costs no stamina and blocked stamina regeneration is allowed. Off keeps the ordinary encumbrance penalty. Other safe-action switches still apply.
strings.cfg_2_foods__health_modifier_help: Multiplier for health value of all foods.
strings.cfg_2_foods__stamina_modifier_help: Multiplier for stamina value of all foods.
strings.cfg_2_foods__duration_modifier_help: Multiplier for how long all foods last. Food Rate in 5 - Exertion also changes this; both apply.
strings.cfg_2_foods__health_regen_modifier_help: Multiplier for health regeneration of all foods.
strings.cfg_2_foods__eitr_modifier_help: Multiplier for eitr value of all foods.
strings.cfg_3_eating__disable_food_degradation_h: When enabled, food stats do not decrease over time.
strings.cfg_3_eating__degradation_curve_help: Exponent of the food strength curve: strength = remaining fraction ^ curve. 0.3 is the game's curve, 1 is linear, higher values make food fade sooner, 0 means no fading. Disable Food Degradation overrides it.
strings.cfg_3_eating__eat_again_at_help: Fraction of a food's duration below which it can be eaten again. The game uses 0.5; 1 allows it at any time, 0 only once the food has run out.
strings.cfg_9_cheats__instant_kitchen_help: Stations finish at the next tick, fermenters are ready at once, and nothing burns.
strings.cfg_9_cheats__endless_food_help: Active food timers hold while enabled.
strings.cfg_9_cheats__eat_anything_help: Food slots never report full and food can be eaten again below its complete duration.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__rested_delay_help: Seconds of resting before Rested is granted. Fire and resting conditions still apply. Default follows the game's Resting effect.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__rested_duration_help: Seconds the Rested effect lasts at comfort level 1. Takes effect the next time a player rests.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__rested_duration_per_comf: Seconds added to Rested Duration for every comfort level above 1. Takes effect the next time a player rests.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__rested_stamina_regen_hel: Stamina regeneration multiplier while rested (1 = no bonus). Combines with the other regen rules like a mead's.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__rested_health_regen_help: Health regeneration multiplier while rested (1 = no bonus).
strings.cfg_4_recovery__rested_eitr_regen_help: Eitr regeneration multiplier while rested (1 = no bonus).
strings.cfg_4_recovery__continuous_food_healing_: Off: food heals its Health Regen once every 10 seconds. On: the same amount is spread over the 10 seconds, applied a little every frame, without floating heal numbers.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__vigor_per_stamina_point_: Percent of stamina regeneration every food grants per point of its configured Stamina while it is active (its Vigor). 0 keeps vanilla; 0.1 turns a 60-stamina food into +6% regeneration, three such foods into +18%. Each food's own Vigor entry adds on top. Stacks with Regen Per Extra Stamina Point, which also counts food stamina; prefer one of the two.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__vigor_multiplier_help: Scales the Vigor of every food. Stacks with Regen Per Extra Stamina Point.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__regen_curve_strength_hel: 1 = off. Above 1 stamina regenerates faster when the bar is low and slower when it is high: at an empty bar regeneration is multiplied by this value, at a full bar divided by it, 1x at the pivot. Below 1 does the opposite. Stacks with Low Stamina Regen Bonus and the game's own low-bar bonus, all boosting an empty bar.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__regen_curve_pivot_help: Bar fraction (0..1) where the regen curve is exactly 1x.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__sneak_skill_regen_bonus_: Percent of stamina regeneration added while crouching and standing still, at Sneak skill 100. Scales with the skill.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__encumbered_regen_fractio: 0 = vanilla, no regeneration while encumbered. Above 0 the player regenerates at this fraction of the normal rate while encumbered (walking still drains).
strings.cfg_4_recovery__swimming_regen_fraction_: 0 = vanilla, no regeneration while swimming. Above 0 the player regenerates at this fraction of the normal rate while in the water, after the swimming regen delay.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__swimming_regen_delay_hel: Seconds after the last swimming stroke before swimming regeneration starts (treading water or floating still).
strings.cfg_4_recovery__regen_per_extra_stamina_: Percent of stamina regeneration added per point of stamina above Base Stamina (and above the skill stamina in 5 - Exertion). 0 keeps vanilla; 0.2 with 150 extra stamina gives +30%. Stacks with Vigor, which also counts food stamina; prefer one of the two. Base Stamina in 5 - Exertion moves the reference point.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__count_food_stamina_only_: Off: extra stamina is the whole maximum above the base, from food, meads, gear and other mods. On: only the current stamina of the active foods counts.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__stamina_regen_multiplier: Scales the base stamina regeneration. 1 = untouched. The curve, Vigor and extra stamina rules apply on top. Multiplies with the world Stamina Regen Rate in 5 - Exertion and with Low Stamina Regen Bonus.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__low_stamina_regen_bonus_: Scales the game's own bonus for a low bar (regeneration rises as the bar empties). 1 = untouched, 0 removes it. Stacks with Regen Curve Strength and Stamina Regen Multiplier.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__stamina_regen_delay_help: Seconds after any stamina use before regeneration resumes. The game uses 1; at 1 Larder does not change it, so another mod's value is kept.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__blocking_regen_factor_he: Stamina regeneration factor while holding block. The game uses 0.8; 1 means no slowdown.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__eitr_vigor_per_eitr_poin: Percent of eitr regeneration every food grants per point of its configured Eitr while it is active (its Eitr Vigor). 0 keeps vanilla. Each food's own EitrVigor entry adds on top.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__eitr_vigor_multiplier_he: Scales the Eitr Vigor of every food.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__eitr_regen_multiplier_he: Scales the base eitr regeneration. 1 = untouched. Eitr Vigor and the eitr curve apply on top.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__eitr_regen_delay_help: Seconds after any eitr use before regeneration resumes. The game uses 1; at 1 Larder does not change it, so another mod's value is kept.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__eitr_regen_curve_strengt: 1 = off. Above 1 eitr regenerates faster when the bar is low and slower when it is high, like the stamina curve. Below 1 does the opposite. Stacks with the game's own low-bar eitr bonus.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__eitr_regen_curve_pivot_h: Eitr bar fraction (0..1) where the eitr regen curve is exactly 1x.
strings.cfg_4_recovery__blocking_eitr_regen_fact: Eitr regeneration factor while holding block. The game uses 0.8; 1 means no slowdown.
strings.cfg_3_eating__food_slots_help: How many foods a player can have active at once. The game uses 3. More slots add a lot of health and stamina; the global multipliers above can balance that. Lowering it keeps extra foods until they run out.
strings.cfg_3_eating__allow_auto_eat_help: When on, a player whose food runs out automatically eats another of the same food from their inventory, if they have one. Each player can still turn it off for themselves with Auto Eat in this section.
strings.cfg_3_eating__auto_eat_help: Eat another of the same food when one runs out, if the server allows it with Allow Auto Eat in this section. Your own choice, not synced from the server.
strings.cfg_6_kitchen__cook_time_multiplier_help: Multiplier on the cook time of every recipe on every cooking station and oven, on top of each recipe's own time in the station's section (one section per station, named after its prefab). 0.5 cooks twice as fast. Food on the fire when the value changes follows at once.
strings.cfg_6_kitchen__food_can_burn_help: On: cooked food left on a station burns as in the game, at twice its cook time. Off: cooked food never burns and waits on the station until it is taken.
strings.cfg_6_kitchen__feast_servings_help: Servings a placed feast holds. 0 keeps each feast's own count. Feasts nobody has eaten from follow a change at once; a feast already started keeps the servings it has left.
strings.cfg_6_kitchen__fermentation_time_help: Seconds a fermenter takes to brew a batch. 0 keeps each barrel's own time (the game's fermenter takes 2400, 40 minutes). Also applies to barrels already brewing: one that has brewed longer than the new time is ready at once.
strings.cfg_6_kitchen__batch_yield_help: Meads tapped from one batch. 0 keeps each recipe's own yield. Applies when a batch is tapped, so it also covers batches already brewing.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__run_cost_help: Multiplier on the stamina drained by running. 1 = untouched, 0 = free, 2 = double. Multiplies with Stamina Rate and Move Stamina Rate in this section, Out Of Combat Run Cost and a mead's RunStaminaModifier.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__jump_cost_help: Multiplier on the stamina drained by jumping. 1 = untouched, 0 = free, 2 = double. Multiplies with Stamina Rate and Move Stamina Rate in this section, Out Of Combat Jump Cost, Skill Discount and a mead's JumpStaminaModifier.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__dodge_cost_help: Multiplier on the stamina drained by dodging. 1 = untouched, 0 = free, 2 = double. Multiplies with Stamina Rate in this section, Out Of Combat Dodge Cost, Skill Discount and the game's own dodge skill discount.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__block_cost_help: Multiplier on the stamina drained by blocking (normal and perfect blocks). 1 = untouched, 0 = free, 2 = double. Multiplies with Stamina Rate in this section and Skill Discount.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__attack_cost_help: Multiplier on the stamina drained by attacking. 1 = untouched, 0 = free, 2 = double. Multiplies with Stamina Rate in this section.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__sneak_cost_help: Multiplier on the stamina drained by sneaking. 1 = untouched, 0 = free, 2 = double. Multiplies with Stamina Rate in this section and Out Of Combat Sneak Cost; Free Sneaking Without Enemies overrides both.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__swim_cost_help: Multiplier on the stamina drained by swimming. 1 = untouched, 0 = free, 2 = double. Multiplies with Stamina Rate and Move Stamina Rate in this section.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__encumbered_cost_help: Multiplier on the stamina drained by walking while encumbered. 1 = untouched, 0 = free, 2 = double. Multiplies with Stamina Rate in this section.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__tool_cost_help: Multiplier on the stamina drained by placing and repairing with the hammer, hoe and cultivator. 1 = untouched, 0 = free, 2 = double. Multiplies with Stamina Rate in this section.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__fishing_pull_cost_help: Multiplier on the stamina drained by reeling in the fishing line. 1 = untouched, 0 = free, 2 = double. Multiplies with Stamina Rate in this section.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__fishing_hooked_cost_help: Multiplier on the stamina drained by holding a hooked fish on the line. 1 = untouched, 0 = free, 2 = double. Multiplies with Stamina Rate in this section.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__harpoon_cost_help: Multiplier on the stamina drained by pulling a harpooned creature. 1 = untouched, 0 = free, 2 = double. Multiplies with Stamina Rate in this section.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__drowning_damage_help: Multiplier on the damage taken each second while swimming without stamina. 1 = untouched, 0 = harmless.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__out_of_combat_run_cost_h: Extra multiplier on the run cost while out of combat: no enemy targets or has noticed the player and the player is not attacking. 1 = no change.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__out_of_combat_jump_cost_: Extra multiplier on the jump cost while out of combat: no enemy targets or has noticed the player and the player is not attacking. 1 = no change.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__out_of_combat_dodge_cost: Extra multiplier on the dodge cost while out of combat: no enemy targets or has noticed the player and the player is not attacking. 1 = no change.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__out_of_combat_sneak_cost: Extra multiplier on the sneak cost while out of combat: no enemy targets or has noticed the player and the player is not attacking. 1 = no change.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__free_sneaking_without_en: Sneaking costs no stamina when no enemy is within stealth range and none has noticed the player.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__skill_discount_help: Percent taken off the block, dodge and jump costs at skill 100 of the matching skill (Blocking, Dodge, Jump). Scales with the skill and applies on top of the game's own discounts, so dodge at skill 100 gets both. Multiplies with the matching cost multipliers.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__base_health_help: Health a player has with no food. The game uses 25; at 25 Larder does not change it, so another mod's value is kept.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__base_stamina_help: Stamina a player has with no food. The game uses 75; at 75 Larder does not change it, so another mod's value is kept. Regen Per Extra Stamina Point counts stamina above this value, so raising it lowers that bonus.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__run_skill_stamina_help: Stamina added to Base Stamina at Run skill 100, scaling linearly with the skill level.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__jump_skill_stamina_help: Stamina added to Base Stamina at Jump skill 100, scaling linearly with the skill level.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__sneak_skill_stamina_help: Stamina added to Base Stamina at Sneak skill 100, scaling linearly with the skill level.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__swim_skill_stamina_help: Stamina added to Base Stamina at Swim skill 100, scaling linearly with the skill level.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__fishing_skill_stamina_he: Stamina added to Base Stamina at Fishing skill 100, scaling linearly with the skill level.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__run_skill_gain_help: Multiplier on the experience the Run skill earns. 1 = untouched. The world's skill gain rate still applies on top.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__jump_skill_gain_help: Multiplier on the experience the Jump skill earns. 1 = untouched. The world's skill gain rate still applies on top.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__sneak_skill_gain_help: Multiplier on the experience the Sneak skill earns. 1 = untouched. The world's skill gain rate still applies on top.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__swim_skill_gain_help: Multiplier on the experience the Swim skill earns. 1 = untouched. The world's skill gain rate still applies on top.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__fishing_skill_gain_help: Multiplier on the experience the Fishing skill earns. 1 = untouched. The world's skill gain rate still applies on top.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__food_rate_help: Overrides the world modifier 'food rate: how fast food runs out' while above 0. 0 leaves the world's value. Applies together with Duration Modifier; Eat Again At is a fraction of the resulting duration.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__stamina_rate_help: Overrides the world modifier 'stamina rate: all stamina use' while above 0. 0 leaves the world's value. Multiplies with every cost multiplier in this section.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__move_stamina_rate_help: Overrides the world modifier 'move stamina rate: running, jumping and swimming' while above 0. 0 leaves the world's value. Multiplies with Run, Jump and Swim Cost in this section and with Stamina Rate.
strings.cfg_5_exertion__stamina_regen_rate_help: Overrides the world modifier 'stamina regen rate' while above 0. 0 leaves the world's value. Multiplies with Stamina Regen Multiplier in 4 - Recovery.
strings.cfg_3_eating__hide_health_number_help: Hides the number on the health bar. Per player, not synced from the server.
strings.cfg_3_eating__hide_stamina_number_help: Hides the number on the stamina bar. Per player, not synced from the server.
strings.cfg_3_eating__hide_eitr_number_help: Hides the number on the eitr bar. Per player, not synced from the server.
strings.cfg_3_eating__food_timers_help: The remaining time under each food icon: Vanilla shows it as the game does (always), Always forces it on, Never hides it. Per player, not synced from the server.
strings.cfg_6_kitchen__fermenter_timer_help: Shows remaining brew time on an accessible, sheltered fermenter while the Cooking module is active. Your local display preference; follows the current Kitchen duration and Cooking speed.
strings.cfg_7_cooking__experience_multiplier_hel: Multiplies all Cooking experience earned at kitchens.
strings.cfg_7_cooking__tier_scaling_help: Richer dishes teach more: experience is multiplied by the dish's health + stamina + eitr divided by Tier Reference Food Value, never below 1.
strings.cfg_7_cooking__tier_reference_food_value: The food value (health + stamina + eitr) that earns the game's own experience.
strings.cfg_7_cooking__tier_maximum_multiplier_h: The most Tier Scaling can multiply experience by.
strings.cfg_7_cooking__discovery_multiplier_help: Experience multiplier the first time a character makes each dish.
strings.cfg_7_cooking__fermenter_tap_experience_: Cooking experience for tapping a fermenter (the game gives none). 0 turns it off.
strings.cfg_7_cooking__cooking_speed_at_level_10: Percent faster cooking on cooking stations and the oven, from the level of the player who put the food on.
strings.cfg_7_cooking__extra_burn_time_at_level_: Extra time before a finished dish burns, in percent of its cook time. The game burns a dish at twice its cook time; 100 moves that to three times.
strings.cfg_7_cooking__fermenting_speed_at_level: Percent faster fermenting, from the level of the player who put the mead base in.
strings.cfg_7_cooking__extra_food_chance_at_leve: Chance in percent of extra food from a kitchen (cooking stations, oven, cauldron, mead cauldron, prep table). Replaces the game's own bonus chance at kitchens. Grows from 0 at level 0.
strings.cfg_7_cooking__extra_food_amount_help: How many extra dishes a bonus gives.
strings.cfg_7_cooking__ingredient_save_chance_at: Chance in percent that crafting at a kitchen gives back one of the ingredients it used.
strings.tpl_food__health_help: Health {0} adds to your maximum while it lasts. Health Modifier in 2 - Foods applies on top. The game's value is the default.
strings.tpl_food__stamina_help: Stamina {0} adds to your maximum while it lasts. Stamina Modifier in 2 - Foods applies on top. The game's value is the default.
strings.tpl_food__duration_help: Seconds {0} lasts after eating. Duration Modifier in 2 - Foods and Food Rate in 5 - Exertion also apply. The game's value is the default.
strings.tpl_food__healthregen_help: Health {0} restores on each regeneration tick while it lasts. Health Regen Modifier in 2 - Foods applies on top. The game's value is the default.
strings.tpl_food__eitr_help: Eitr {0} adds to your maximum while it lasts. Eitr Modifier in 2 - Foods applies on top. The game's value is the default.
strings.tpl_food__vigor_help: Extra Vigor of {0}: percent added to stamina regeneration while the food is active, on top of its Stamina times Vigor Per Stamina Point. Does not fade with the food. Stacks with Regen Per Extra Stamina Point.
strings.tpl_food__eitrvigor_help: Extra Eitr Vigor of {0}: percent added to eitr regeneration while the food is active, on top of its Eitr times Eitr Vigor Per Eitr Point. Does not fade with the food.
strings.tpl_mead__duration_help: Duration of {0} effect in seconds. While it runs, neither this mead nor another of its group (the healing meads, for example) can be drunk, so this is also the mead's cooldown.
strings.tpl_mead__healthovertime_help: Total health restored over time by {0}.
strings.tpl_mead__staminaovertime_help: Total stamina restored over time by {0}.
strings.tpl_mead__eitrovertime_help: Total eitr restored over time by {0}.
strings.tpl_mead__healthregenmultiplier_help: Health regeneration multiplier while {0} lasts (1 = no change).
strings.tpl_mead__staminaregenmultiplier_help: Stamina regeneration multiplier while {0} lasts (1 = no change). Combines with the stamina rules in 4 - Recovery, like the game's own meads.
strings.tpl_mead__eitrregenmultiplier_help: Eitr regeneration multiplier while {0} lasts (1 = no change). Combines with the eitr rules in 4 - Recovery.
strings.tpl_mead__runstaminamodifier_help: Added fraction of the run stamina drain while {0} lasts: -0.2 makes running 20% cheaper.
strings.tpl_mead__jumpstaminamodifier_help: Added fraction of the jump stamina cost while {0} lasts: -0.2 makes jumping 20% cheaper.
strings.tpl_station__recipe_help: Seconds {0} takes to cook into {1} on this station. Cook Time Multiplier in 6 - Kitchen applies on top.
